title: Pyramids in the Elysium region

tellings.quote: probes photographed huge pyramids some 500 M High some with four sides just like the Great Pyramids of Giza

plain: Space probes are said to have photographed huge pyramids on Mars, in a region called Elysium, some about 500 metres high and some with four sides "just like the Great Pyramids of Giza". Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and does not say which probes or when. If true, it would suggest that something once built structures on Mars.
